blurb: Krootz Brewing Company offers traditional and experimental ales and lagers along with a full service scratch kitchen. They serve lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch with a menu including burgers, BBQ, nachos, wings, pizzas, entrées, and homemade desserts. The venue features many large screen TVs and is family friendly, open 7 days a week.
